title: Pondering Pompom Pufferfish
statement: A pale-lavender pufferfish, round as a dandelion clock and fringed with soft, pompom-like fins, drifts through a lantern-lit tank of sea glass, curling kelp and one tilted teacup. It stops often to think, blowing a single slow bubble and watching it rise, then puffs up with delight when the bubble reaches the top without popping.
